timeline.label: OCC grants preliminary conditional approval for de novo Nubank, N.A. (In Organization); LatAm remains primary growth engine while US groundwork runs in 2026
FY2025 close: 131M customers, US$41.9B deposits, US$15.8B revenue, US$2.87B NI; Brazil ~113M customers
Filed OCC national bank charter and FDIC deposit insurance applications for US expansion
Acquired Hyperplane (US AI platform) to strengthen underwriting and model stack
FY2024: 114.2M customers; crossed 100M Brazil customers milestone during 2024
Mexico Cuenta Nu deposit account launch; later raised rates to compete for balances
NYSE IPO as Nu Holdings Ltd. (NU); founder David Vélez retains high Class B voting control
Nubank founded in Brazil as digital-first consumer finance challenger

industry.structure: Brazilian retail finance is a mix of large incumbents (Itaú, Bradesco, Santander, public banks) and scaled digital players. Nu leads digital customer counts; Mercado Pago is the main marketplace-fintech rival in payments and cards; Sea Monee is embedding credit via Shopee.
industry.share_shift: Digital players are taking most incremental card and account growth. Nu still leads absolute credit customers and deposit scale among digitals; Mercado Pago is gaining faster on some client-add and card-growth metrics; Monee is small but growing very fast off a low Brazil base.
industry.trend: Open Finance, Pix, and high real rates keep the battlefield open. Proprietary underwriting (bank cash-flow data vs commerce graphs) decides who wins revolving credit; primary-account stickiness decides who keeps cheap funding.
